name: /docs
purpose: Provides quick access to SYNARA's documentation, allowing administrators to browse available guides and reference material directly from Discord.

name: /setup
purpose: Launches the SYNARA Setup Wizard, providing a guided process for configuring required channels, roles, users, and other server settings needed by SYNARA's features.

name: !nickname
purpose: Sets the preferred name SYNARA will use when speaking to you. Running the command again replaces your existing nickname, while running it without a name removes your saved nickname.

name: !draw
purpose: Generate artwork based on your description. SYNARA interprets your prompt creatively to produce a unique image, and occasional drawing glitches are an intentional part of her personality.

name: !birthday
purpose: Registers or updates your birthday using the MM/DD format. SYNARA stores only the month and day, never the birth year. Running the command again replaces your previously saved birthday.

name: !nextBirthdays
purpose: Displays all registered birthdays occurring during the next three months so members can see upcoming celebrations within the community.

name: /sticky
purpose: Creates or removes a sticky message for the current channel. Sticky messages automatically return to the bottom of the channel after conversations slow down, ensuring important information remains visible.

subOptions.name: Create
subOptions.description: Create a sticky message for the current channel.

subOptions.name: Delete
subOptions.description: Remove the sticky message from the current channel.

name: /feature
purpose: Enables or disables individual SYNARA features for the current server. Feature availability is managed independently for each Discord server.

name: /features
purpose: Displays the current status of every SYNARA feature, allowing administrators to quickly determine which features are enabled or disabled for the server.

name: /settings
purpose: Displays the server's current SYNARA configuration, including configured channels, roles, users, ignored channels, and other settings used by enabled features.

name: /ignorechannel
purpose: Controls which channels SYNARA observes for natural conversation. Ignored channels are excluded from SYNARA's Observation feature.

subOptions.name: Add
subOptions.description: Add the current channel to SYNARA's ignored channel list.

subOptions.name: Remove
subOptions.description: Remove the current channel from SYNARA's ignored channel list.

name: /setrole
purpose: Assigns a Discord role to one of SYNARA's configurable role settings. Configured roles are used by various features such as verification, birthdays, moderation, and other automated systems.

name: /removerole
purpose: Removes a configured administrator or moderator role from the server's SYNARA configuration. This command only affects role assignments managed by SYNARA and does not delete the Discord role itself.

name: /setchannel
purpose: Assigns a Discord channel to one of SYNARA's configurable channel settings. These settings determine where automated announcements, messages, and feature output are posted.

name: /setuser
purpose: Assigns a Discord user to one of SYNARA's configurable user settings, such as the Counting Bot or Server Leader, allowing features that depend on specific users to function correctly.

name: /commands
purpose: Displays a complete list of administrative commands available to users with the appropriate permissions.

name: !commands
purpose: Displays a complete list of community commands available to all members, along with a brief description of each command.

name: /embed
purpose: Creates a professional Discord embed that appears as though it was sent directly by SYNARA. A private preview is shown before the embed is published, allowing administrators to review or cancel it.

name: /event
purpose: Creates and manages scheduled announcements that SYNARA automatically publishes according to their configured schedule. Supports both recurring and one-time events.

subOptions.name: Manage Scheduled Event
subOptions.description: Edit, pause, resume, skip, or delete an existing scheduled announcement.

name: !bonk
purpose: Playfully bonk another member. SYNARA tracks bonks as part of a lighthearted community feature, and rare self-bonks may occur randomly.

name: !points
purpose: Displays your current Efficiency Point total, allowing you to track your progress and compare your activity within the community.

name: !linktwitch
purpose: Links your Twitch account to SYNARA using your Twitch username. Once linked, SYNARA can monitor your streams, announce when you go live, and track your Twitch statistics.

name: !mytwitch
purpose: Displays the Twitch account currently linked to your Discord account so you can verify your configuration.

name: !unlinktwitch
purpose: Removes the Twitch account currently linked to your Discord account. You can relink a different Twitch account at any time using !linktwitch.

name: !twitchstats
purpose: Displays Twitch statistics collected for your linked Twitch account, including information tracked by SYNARA.

name: /modapps
purpose: Controls the complete moderator application system, including opening and closing applications and managing the moderator application blacklist.

subOptions.name: Blacklist Add
subOptions.description: Add a user to the moderator application blacklist.

subOptions.name: Blacklist Remove
subOptions.description: Remove a user from the moderator application blacklist.

subOptions.name: Blacklist List
subOptions.description: Display every user currently on the moderator application blacklist.

name: !trivia
purpose: Starts a round of trivia and records your results as part of SYNARA's ongoing trivia leaderboard and statistics system.

name: !leaderboard
purpose: Displays the trivia leaderboard along with your personal trivia statistics, allowing members to compare their long-term performance.

name: !joke
purpose: Ask SYNARA to share one of her jokes. Responses are intended to be lighthearted and reflect her unique personality and sense of humor.

name: !fact
purpose: Receive a random interesting fact accompanied by SYNARA's own thoughts and commentary to make learning more engaging.
